periods.summary: Douglas Upton leads the U.S. Pacific Fleet into Japan's EEZ, rejects Japanese warnings, and announces that the United States and Union will punish Japan for alleged League collusion with Rebellion. His initial sea manipulation destroys a Self-Defense aircraft and he threatens indiscriminate bombing of Tokyo unless Japan disarms. Later, after Kurono destroys several ships, Upton reveals his enormous Device, the super aerial battleship Enterprise. He floats it overhead, praises Kurono's restraint, and opens battle with its giant strong-particle cannons. Because Enterprise could pierce Tokyo's underground shelters if it landed, Upton becomes the central Tokyo-front threat.

periods.summary: Douglas Upton commands the US Pacific Fleet from the enormous aviation battleship Device Enterprise. He believes the United States is fighting to punish the League's evil and repeatedly frames civilian sacrifice as justice. Enterprise's living metal lets it shed Kurono's aging bullets and regenerate, while its hadron cannons threaten Tokyo's underground shelters. After PSYON opens the ground front, Upton fires Justicefier, but Kurono rewrites time to stop the shot. He then attempts to rebuild the cannon, only for Nene's meteor to smash Enterprise. Even after losing an arm and his ship burning, Upton refuses withdrawal and fires again; Stella intercepts the beam with Calusaritio Salamander and destroys Enterprise.

key_events.summary: Uses PSYON's breakthrough to line up Enterprise's main cannon on Tokyo.
Has his first Justicefier shot undone by Kurono's awakening.
Enterprise is smashed by Nene, then finally destroyed by Stella when Upton refuses retreat.
